_comment: Scene edits COOHAVIOR S3-V4-* make to Beechwood_1_int, reproduced here.
deactivate: the `active = false` overs in the staging scene's own BehaviorScene
block (S3-V4-HH.usda; identical across the four difficulties), kept
where the name exists in our dataset's scene. 16 of COOHAVIOR's do not:

bottom_cabinet_bamfsz_0, shelf_njwsoa_0, shelf_njwsoa_1, shelf_owvfik_0, shelf_owvfik_1, shelf_owvfik_2, shelf_owvfik_3, shelf_owvfik_4, shelf_owvfik_5, shelf_owvfik_6, shelf_owvfik_7, shelf_owvfik_8, shelf_vgzdul_0, sink_ksecxq_0, sink_ksecxq_1, sink_zexzrc_0
No moves. COOHAVIOR moves its route supports to station centres, but its
Beechwood frame is not ours (its stations fall outside or in the wrong rooms
here), so the supports stay where our scene has them. The sampler keeps
anything the BDDL binds to, whatever this list says.
box_mass_kg is per task (LL/HL 0.008, LH/HH 0.02); the sampler overrides it.
